name: hd_fs30_grid_pilot_fixed
notes: HD^free enhanced hybrid pilot, fixed-step variant (docs/FS_PILOT.md Sec. 14). Launched after hd_fs30_grid_pilot was aborted by its pre-set warmup rule (step-size dual averaging starting at 0.025 still cost ~120 s per 8-chain iteration, > 35 min for 25 iterations). Its notes said 'relaunch nothing'; this separately committed run deviates from that, documented in FS_PILOT.md, because the kernel question is untested otherwise and the budget (<= 3 GPU-h) allows it. Identical to hd_fs30_grid_pilot except: no adaptation, fixed step size 0.025 and 1 non-adapting warmup iteration, exactly as pilot E and the hybrid pilot (matched baseline). Kernel, frozen proposals (hd_fs30_v2.json), grid moves (f_1, f_2, 3x f_3 jointly with J1713+0747 / J1909-3744 / J0030+0451 IRN, f_4, f_8) and the frozen relevance declaration as before. Hard sampling cap 2 h (max_sampling_seconds 7200; fewer draws accepted). Success = replicated f_3 entries AND exits (>= 2 chains) plus improved occupancy MCSE vs the hybrid pilot (8 x 100).
